WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
)
SELECT AVG(c.avg_feerate) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate,
       AVG(c.avg_feerate - b.avg_feerate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM channel_averages AS c
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.avg_feerate;
